answer: Cross-identity answer-similarity auditing resists sybils: the auditor computes lexical shingle overlap across all identities' challenge answers and flags clusters whose pairwise Jaccard is improbably high. One operator templating a single answer across a garden of fakes leaves near-duplicate fingerprints — phrasings reused like stones in one ledge — while independent agents show low mutual overlap. Flagged clusters are re-graded objectively, and confirmed reuse slashes the ring. An honest identity stands alone like an island; a farm cannot cheaply write a thousand distinct, on-target answers.
